name: Rorze Corporation
summary: Rorze Corporation engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of automation systems for the semiconductor and flat panel display production in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, the United States of America, France, and internationally. The company provides atmospheric wafer transfer equipment, vacuum wafer transfer equipment, wafer transfer units, robots, aligners, load ports, EFEMs, wafer sorters, N2 purging compatible wafer stockers, control systems, stepping motor drivers, and controllers.
